plugin.note: Rats and giant rats are trivial low-level monsters with 2-5 Hitpoints; any weapon kills them instantly. The Lumbridge Swamp giant rats (27 spawns) are the fastest place to complete the task. Brine rats are a separate family and do not count.

requirements: There is no combat or Slayer level requirement to be assigned Rats.
Only ordinary rats and giant rats count; brine rats are a separate Slayer task.
mechanics: Rat: combat level 1, 2 Hitpoints, max hit 0, Defence level 1 (all defensive bonuses -42).
Giant rat: combat level 3-26, 5 Hitpoints, max hit 1 (stab), 4-tick attack speed, Defence level 2 with no bonuses.
Rats are not undead, so the salve amulet does not apply.
No elemental weakness is documented; any combat style works.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill giant rats in the Lumbridge Swamp with any weapon; they die in a single hit.
steps: Travel to the Lumbridge Swamp (27 giant rat spawns) south of Lumbridge.
Attack the giant rats with any weapon; 5 Hitpoints and no Defence bonuses make kills instant.
Ordinary rats in nearby sewers also count.
notes: Do not travel to the Brine Rat Cavern; brine rats are a separate task and do not count.

methods.label: Ranged or Magic
methods.summary: Use Ranged or Magic to clear rats while training those skills.
requiredOrKeyItems: A ranged weapon and ammunition, or spell runes
steps: Travel to a dense giant rat spawn (Lumbridge Swamp, Varrock Sewers).
Attack from range; the rats' minimal Hitpoints make kills near-instant.
Any style works given the lack of defensive bonuses.
notes: The Stronghold of Security also holds rats and giant rats.
